text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — LunaHealth preview cohort enrollment is stuck. We only have 4/12 seats confirmed. They hit an SSO failure during SAML handshake (Okta) with an 'invalid_cert' error. Customer is asking if we can get them into the sandbox this week for the evaluation demo.
Sam: Ugh. Do we have the exact IdP metadata they used? can they re-upload cert?
Maya: I asked for the metadata and cert already, they uploaded a bundle but our logs show a cert mismatch when validating signature. I don't think it's user error — might be our cert parsing.
Jordan: tagging PM — @Sam can you confirm whether this blocks the entire cohort rollout or just LunaHealth? Need to know renewal risk if they can't demo.
Sam: This is per-tenant — only LunaHealth for now, but if we don't fix quickly they'll push back on renewal conversation. I'll jump on it.
Ravi: I can triage parsing flow. Maya, can you paste the debug log snippet here? also run `curl -v https://idp.lunahealth.com/metadata` and paste headers if possible.
Maya: Pasted log below: ```ERROR SAMLValidate: signature verification failed: x509: certificate signed by unknown authority (possibly missing intermediate)```
Maya: I ran the curl and they return 200 but the cert chain looks trimmed. I asked them to provide full chain.
Sam: Temporary workaround: we can add a manual cert thumbprint accept for the preview org to get them in ASAP — low risk since it's a short-lived preview. Approve?
Jordan: We should only do manual thumbprint if OnboardBot logs audit and CS captures consent. If we do that, put a note in renewal-risk doc that we granted a temporary exception.
Maya: LunaHealth already signed the preview terms and acknowledged risk. They want the demo Friday.
Ravi: Ok — I'll add a short-term parser tolerance and validate that we still verify signature alg. I can push a hotfix to staging tonight. Needs a quick review.
Sam: I'll create a support ticket and a PR for the manual thumbprint path so it's auditable.
OnboardBot: Support ticket #9876 created for LunaHealth SSO failure. Reminder scheduled: follow-up in 24h.
Jordan: Can Product Ops join the Friday demo? PM wants to see if latency/embedding quality meets their use case before renewal.
Maya: Yes, schedule for Fri 10:00 AM PST — I'll invite LunaHealth, Sam (AM), Jordan (PM), Ravi (DevEx). OnboardBot, please send calendar invites and a pre-demo checklist.
OnboardBot: Calendar invites sent to LunaHealth + internal attendees. Pre-demo checklist: confirm SSO test account, sample prompt set loaded, and 3 perf scenarios.
Sam: I'll lead SSO provisioning today and update ticket with cert chain. Ravi — ping me when your patch is in staging, I'll validate with their metadata.
Ravi: Will do. ETA for patch: 6 hours.
Maya: Thanks everyone. Action items: Sam=provision + ticket updates; Ravi=hotfix + announce when ready; Jordan=prep demo agenda and renewal note; Maya=confirm attendee list and send pre-demo survey. Follow-up in thread tomorrow. :thumbsup:
